summary.dataset: ICFD-31k (synthetic; evaluation only): full test split (4,500 calls) and cross-domain split (1,000 calls)
caveats: ICFD-31k is synthetic (LLM-generated); numbers say nothing about real-world accuracy.
Non-fraud calls are rare in ICFD (62 of 5,500), and most are reverse scenarios where the customer, not the agent, is the suspicious party; the specificity interval is therefore wide.
Fraud calls are a stratified random sample (seed recorded); the keyword baseline is run on every call.
Undetermined counts as not flagged. Plausible scam type uses our own domain-to-type mapping.
